findings.desc: currentRunBasisMatches fails open when freshness recomputation is unavailable. The ledger basis may contain headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash from run start, but packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:807-820 only reports drift when both the recorded hash and the freshly recomputed hash are truthy; if currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHashExcludingOutputs returns undefined (wrong git root, missing .git, git failure, or ls-tree failure), the function returns matches:true. autopilotResume then treats staleReason as empty at packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1789-1824 and can return resume_ready for a run whose basis freshness could not be verified. This contradicts the M1 fail-closed requirement for stale/corrupt state and is not covered by packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts, which covers changed/stale values but not unavailable freshness probes. SourceRefs: packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:807-820; packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1789-1824; packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts:221-267.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 0eddf8fba and refreshed in later metadata: currentRunBasisMatches now refuses when headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash cannot be recomputed; autopilot-resume smoke temporarily moves .git and verifies refused/stale_state instead of resume_ready.

findings.desc: Policy/runtime drift is frozen into the checkpoint ledger but is not recomputed during autopilot_resume before returning resume_ready. The M1 plan requires policy digest or policy-declared runtime input changes to mark old checkpoints stale/plan_drift instead of silently consuming them as done (docs/requirements/decisions/autopilot-v2-reliability-execution-plan.md:193, docs/requirements/decisions/autopilot-v2-reliability-execution-plan.md:211, docs/requirements/decisions/autopilot-v2-reliability-execution-plan.md:228). The implementation records validityPolicyDigest and producerRuntimeIdentity in buildRunBasis (packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:578) but currentRunBasisMatches only compares headHash, materialHash, and storyFilesHash (packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:807), and autopilotResume uses only that limited basisFreshness before status=resume_ready (packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1789). A changed autopilot policy/runtime can therefore silently reuse committed done checkpoints, overclaiming M1 resume safety.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 0eddf8fba: runBasis now stores producerRuntimeInput, resume recomputes validityPolicyDigest and producerRuntimeIdentity from frozen inputs/current policy, and autopilot-resume smoke mutates the policy to verify refused/stale_state on policy drift.

findings.desc: Policy drift is only partially fail-closed. packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:562 builds validityPolicyDigest from dispatchPolicy/mode/stop flags/requireServerReceipt, omitting persisted policy fields such as maxIterations/maxRuntimeMinutes/maxBudgetUSD and permission booleans. packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:851 then treats that narrow digest as the current-policy drift gate. Verified with a temp-repo node probe after npm --prefix packages/main run build: create AP-policy-maxiterations under policy fake maxIterations=1, overwrite the same policy with maxIterations=2, then run autopilot_resume -- it returned status=resume_ready with remainingSteps=0 instead of refused reason=stale_state. This violates the B-c7e2:F-002 expectation that current policy drift fails closed as stale_state.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 2da692dde: buildValidityPolicyDigest now includes maxIterations, maxRuntimeMinutes, maxBudgetUSD, autopilot permission booleans, and the existing policy semantics. autopilot-resume smoke now mutates maxIterations from 1 to 2 and verifies refused/stale_state rather than resume_ready.

findings.desc: Targeted re-review: unavailable freshness probe fail-closed is now covered by packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts:333-350, but policy/runtime drift coverage for the resolved high finding is still too narrow. The smoke only recreates policy fake with requireServerReceipt changed at packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts:294-314 and expects refused/stale_state. It does not cover drift in other persisted policy/runtime-affecting fields such as maxIterations, maxRuntimeMinutes, maxBudgetUSD, or permission booleans. That gap matters because buildValidityPolicyDigest currently hashes only dispatchPolicy/mode/stop flags/requireServerReceipt at packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:562-571 before autopilotResume returns resume_ready from packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1868-1889. Round-2 finding B-c7e2:F-003 independently verifies maxIterations drift still resumes instead of failing closed, so the tests do not yet fully cover the resolved policy/runtime drift high finding.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 2da692dde: policy drift smoke now covers maxIterations drift, the exact gap independently verified by B-c7e2:F-003, while the same smoke keeps stale checkpoint, corrupt snapshot, early failed run, and unavailable freshness fail-closed coverage.
